name: Daniel Kim
met_context: Judge at the Long Beach innovation hub hackathon
summary: Startup founder (water quality sensors) who shares his pitch deck and is hiring a part-time ML intern.

notes.text: Hackathon at the Long Beach innovation hub - Daniel Kim was a judge. Founder/CEO of Tidewell, a startup with low-cost water quality sensors for fish farms. Raised a pre-seed round last year. Very open about fundraising, said he'd share his pitch deck with anyone building a startup.
Coffee with Daniel Kim. Tidewell is looking for a part-time ML intern for anomaly detection on sensor time series. He asked if I'd be interested or know someone. Paid, remote possible.
